invariants: one visible request and a cross-extension FIFO
monotonic request identity rejects stale answers
confirm cancellation returns false while select and input return null
promoted requests reset selection and input state
select navigation wraps at both ends
titles labels bodies options and initial text are terminal-sanitized
input initial text retains leading and trailing spaces
confirmation bodies retain at most six authored lines
soft reload drains pending requests without closing the queue
unmount drains and permanently closes the queue
expired capability leases cancel instead of accepting
only host-designated native UI may omit extension attribution

nativeProtocolAdaptation.handlerSettlement: dialog answers are returned through typed JSON-RPC submission callbacks
nativeProtocolAdaptation.rendering: Ratatui reads the host-owned queue directly instead of subscribing through React useSyncExternalStore
nativeProtocolAdaptation.workspaceWrite: host-mediated workspace confirmation participates in the same FIFO
